items.text: Zyardil was one of the twenty swarms that stayed loyal to Yelamaiszin, the First, helping guard Akinah and voting on important decisions.

When the Wandersail sailed for Akinah, Zyardil argued with other swarms over how to stop the humans. Unlike Yelamaiszin, it did not think Dalinar would destroy the Sleepless, and it warned that killing an exploring crew would only bring more expeditions. It urged Yelamaiszin to listen to younger swarms like Nikliasorm.
